title: Audit Trail Integrity & Tenant Attribution Readiness

checks.evidence: Generic AuditEvent schema has no visible tenantId/organizationId field.
checks.recommendation: Decide a backward-compatible tenant attribution plan; do not silently infer tenant from email.

checks.evidence: AuditService.list currently appears to query without a tenant filter.
checks.recommendation: Review owner-role semantics and organization context; ensure list results are scoped where multi-tenant policy requires it.

checks.evidence: Checks required actor/action/entity field declarations in generic audit schema.
checks.recommendation: Validate actor identity, action vocabulary, entity identity and event time at write boundaries.

checks.evidence: Looks for visible immutable/append-only enforcement in generic audit schema/service.
checks.recommendation: Consider append-only database permissions, restricted update/delete paths, and tamper-evident export; timestamps alone are not immutability.

checks.evidence: Owner role decorator is visible on audit listing route.
checks.recommendation: Verify global guards and actual role enforcement in runtime tests.

checks.evidence: FinancialAuditEntry schema has no visible tenantId/organizationId field.
checks.recommendation: Trace tenant ownership of all source models and ensure generated snapshot entries inherit validated tenant context.

checks.evidence: Financial audit snapshot queries show no visible tenant filter in the inspected service.
checks.recommendation: Review every source query and generated audit-entry write for tenant scoping before multi-tenant production use.

checks.evidence: Checks for visible redaction/sanitization/allowlist signals in audit services.
checks.recommendation: Ensure metadata/details exclude credentials, tokens, secrets, and unnecessary personal or financial data.

limitations: Text-based source inspection only; no API, database, build, or runtime security tests were executed.
SIGNAL_PRESENT does not prove runtime enforcement or complete tenant isolation.
Do not add tenant attribution by guesswork; existing audit.record call sites currently pass actor and event data without an explicit tenant argument.
Production clearance requires a reviewed migration strategy, role/tenant runtime tests, and database-level retention/tamper controls.
